prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Layout changes to the path selection stage significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in reassurance hints, and path selection incentives significantly hurt conversion.
Copy changes, step reordering, wait-time info and notifications, photo upload guidance, and layout changes to other stages showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for path selection stage layout changes.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in hints, and path selection incentives.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: -15.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.1% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, incentive: -8.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +6.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.3% over 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.7% over 3 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -0.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a card layout featuring structured pet identity fields and official confirmation cards. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9% with long mean completion times (1017s); a clean card layout streamlines certificate confirmation.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Screen Layout: Re-layout the story screen using a split view layout combining story visuals on one side with onboarding narrative copy on the other. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s; presenting story context in a side-by-side split layout helps users digest information faster.)
2: [home, new_screen] New Desktop Companion Setup Screen: Insert a new screen before the waiting stage to introduce desktop overlay permissions and screen placement options. (why: Three support emails reported pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open upon initial render.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Account Sync Sign In Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to assure users that signing in permanently saves and syncs their desktop pet to their account. (why: 8 support tickets (the largest bug category) cited missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro completion screen into a split layout clearly separating desktop controls from interaction guides. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Realtime Progress Timer: Add an explicit time estimate switch and visual progress timer component on the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting step (home target step) takes a mean time of 2336s, leading to user dropoff without visual timing feedback.)
6: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Resolution Hint: Add a photo quality guidance hint explaining optimal lighting and framing on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet creation failing or producing distorted results.)
7: [sign_in, reorder] Adoption Certificate Before Sign In Order: Move sign_in to occur immediately after completing the adoption certificate step rather than before pet creation. (why: Adoption drops off significantly (60.9%); placing pet adoption before sign in builds emotional investment before requesting account registration.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Journey Expectations Copy: Update choose path body copy to outline the quick adoption steps immediately following path selection. (why: Choose path stage has a high mean duration (514s), indicating user hesitation when picking a path without clear expectations.)

scores.note: Adoption has high dropoff, but previous adoption redesigns resulted in a -2.1% lift.
Layout changes on path selection are proven to work well (+6.3% historically).
Adding new adoption/setup screens historically degrades funnel conversion significantly.
